description_en: Retrieves the list of knowledge bases in a specified workspace
description_zh: 获取指定业务空间下知识库列表
name: ListIndices

parameters.help_en:
The name of the knowledge base. You can search for a knowledge base by name. The name must be 1 to 20 characters in length and can contain characters in the Unicode letter category (including English letters, Chinese characters, and digits). The name can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

Default value: empty, which queries all knowledge bases in the specified workspace
parameters.help_zh:
知识库的名称。支持通过名称查找知识库。长度为 1~20 个字符，支持 Unicode 中 letter 分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。

默认值为空，即查询指定业务空间下的所有知识库
parameters.name: index_name

parameters.help_en: The page number to query. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的页码。起始值为 1。默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of knowledge bases to display per page in a paged query. No maximum limit.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时每页展示的知识库数量。最大值不限。
默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the knowledge base belongs. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 知识库所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

ChunkSize.description_en: The estimated chunk size. Valid value range: [1-2048]
ChunkSize.description_zh: 分段预估长度。可能值范围[1-2048]

recommend：推荐配置。
user-defined：自定义

Separator.description_en:
The sentence separator. If multiple separators are used, they are separated by ｜. Valid values:
\
: line break
，: Chinese comma
,: English comma
。: Chinese period
.: English period
！: Chinese exclamation mark
!: English exclamation mark
；: Chinese semicolon
;: English semicolon
？: Chinese question mark
?: English question mark
Separator.description_zh:
分句标识符。如果有多个分句标识符，则用 ｜ 分隔。可能值：
\n：换行
，：中文逗号
,：英文逗号
。：中文句号
.：英文句号
！:中文叹号
!：英文叹号
；：中文分号
;：英文分号
？：中文问号
?：英文问号
